### Grand Prix points

At full points, the top 10 score 25, 18, 15, 12, 10, 8, 6, 4, 2 and 1. Shortened races can use reduced scales.

### Sprint points count too

The top eight in a completed Sprint score from 8 points for P1 down to 1 point for P8.

### What the gaps mean

Gap ahead compares a driver with the next position. Gap leader measures the full deficit to the championship leader.

### Drivers tied on points

Countback separates them: most race wins, then most second places, third places and so on. Qualifying results are the final tie-breaker.

## Singapore Grand Prix Results

Round 17 · October 11, 2026

### Who leads the 2026 F1 driver standings?

Andrea Kimi Antonelli leads with 340 points after Round 17.

### How many points does an F1 race winner receive?

A winner receives 25 points when full points are awarded. Reduced scales can apply when a race covers less than 75% distance.

### Do F1 drivers score points in Sprints?

Yes. The top eight score 8–7–6–5–4–3–2–1 when the Sprint meets the distance requirement.

### How is a tie in the driver standings decided?

The driver with more race wins ranks higher, followed by second places, third places and subsequent results.

Antonelli's second place at Zandvoort and five Sprint points moved him to 242. Russell scored 23 across the weekend and Hamilton 14, leaving both on 183; Russell holds second on countback because he has two Grand Prix wins to Hamilton's one. Norris collected 31 points from third in the Sprint and victory in the Grand Prix, passing Leclerc for fourth.

Hadjar remains eighth despite missing the Dutch weekend with a wrist injury. Lawson's substitute appearance for Red Bull added six points to the total he had built with Racing Bulls, so both teams are listed in his season entry. Tsunoda returned for Racing Bulls at Zandvoort but did not score.

Formula One - Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team, 2026 Australian GP. Kimi Antonelli, George Russell
The F1 standings of the current 2026 Formula 1 season. The season was set to have 24 GPs, but the war in the Middle East led to the cancellation of the Bahrain and Saudi Arabian Grands Prix, which would have made it one of the longest seasons ever in the history of Formula 1.
This year there will be two events in Spain. A new event in 2026 is the Madrid Grand Prix, it will mark the first time a Grand Prix has been held on the streets of Madrid.
On the other hand, the Dutch Grand Prix will be held for the last time. The event had become too expensive for the organizers. It changed the way F1 events are hosted and will certainly be missed.
After the Singapore Grand Prix (round 17 of 23), Kimi Antonelli leads the 2026 Drivers' Championship with 340 points, a commanding 102 points clear of Mercedes teammate George Russell. Antonelli has eight wins, six poles and 14 podiums to his name so far this season. The Italian driver is chasing a maiden World Drivers' Championship. Max Verstappen won the most recent Grand Prix at Marina Bay Street Circuit. Mercedes lead the Constructors' Championship with 578 points and eleven race wins, 134 points clear of Ferrari.
With 6 rounds left to race, 150 points are still up for grabs in the Drivers' Championship and 258 in the Constructors'. Kimi Antonelli could clinch as early as the next round, by outscoring George Russell by 24 there. Kimi Antonelli still has company at the top, with George Russell, Lewis Hamilton, Max Verstappen, Charles Leclerc and Lando Norris mathematically in title contention. The next race is the United States Grand Prix on 25 October 2026 at Circuit of The Americas.
